name: Craft Dorje [Psionic] [Item Creation]
body:
You can create small devices that store knowledge of psionic powers.

Prerequisite(s): Manifester level 5th

Benefit(s): You can create a dorje of any psionic power you know (barring exceptions as noted in a power’s description). Crafting a dorje takes one day for each 1,000 gp in its base price. A newly created dorje has 50 charges.
